rules.description: amount above the segment limit (retail 10,000; business 100,000)
at least 10 payments from from_acct within 60 s of payment time
at least 5 payments of 5.00 or less from from_acct within 300 s of payment time
raw-gbm-v1 score at or above the bank's hold_at (or verify_at), tuned on validation for at most a 2% hold rate
X-Cluster-Risk at least 0.8 gives HOLD; X-Edge-Action: stepup gives at least VERIFY
